other_failure_modes.name: Test Data Leakage via Feature Engineering
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes feature engineering statistics (such as frequency encoding) using the combined train and test datasets. This leaks information about the test set distribution into the training features.

summary: The agent implements a decent cross-validation structure and handles missing values properly, but fails to actually evaluate the validation folds, leaving it blind to model performance. Furthermore, there is a critical test data leakage in the frequency encoding step, and the models are combined using a naive unweighted ensemble.
